title: Full-Stack AI Developer Career Path
description: Competency graph for building end-to-end AI-powered web applications with modern frontend, backend, LLM agents, and vector storage.

web_frontend.name: Frontend Architecture (React & Modern UI)
web_frontend.description: Modern component-based frontend engineering, state management, and responsive UI design.

web_backend.name: Backend Engineering & API Design
web_backend.description: RESTful API design, FastAPI/Node async patterns, authentication, and background task queues.

db_systems.name: Relational & Document Databases
db_systems.description: Relational schema design (PostgreSQL/SQLite), indexing, transactions, ORMs, and query optimization.

llm_integration.name: LLM Integration & Function Calling
llm_integration.description: Prompt engineering, structured output validation (Pydantic), tool calling, and streaming responses.

vector_db_rag.name: Vector Databases & RAG Pipelines
vector_db_rag.description: Embedding models, semantic search, vector indexing (Chroma/Pinecone), chunking strategies, and retrieval-augmented generation.

fullstack_deployment.name: Cloud Deployment & DevOps
fullstack_deployment.description: Containerization with Docker, reverse proxies, cloud hosting (Streamlit Cloud, Render, AWS), and CI/CD.
